# `info-changed`

info (contact, license, terms) changed

| | |
|---|---|

| **Rule IDs** | `info-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |

## What it detects

`info` changed: contact, license or terms of service.

## Why this default

Documentation only.

## Example

From test case [`info-changed`](../../test/cases/info-changed/): The contact in info changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
    version: 1.0.0
    contact:
-     email: a@example.com
+     email: b@example.com
  paths:
    '/pets':
```

Findings:

- `info-changed` · info · document
